scope: Eight original unpaid pilot drafts; source, language and task annotations only
sourceQualifications: Official sources establish slowly spoken everyday comprehension and task objectives, not an exhaustive grammar list or an SSML percentage.

The situations, Japanese speech, alternatives, explanations and picture specifications are original. Only owned structural templates and functional task instructions are reused from docs/listening-task-examples.
Familiar reductions retain the scenario's relationship and are explained selectively. No real pronunciation, pace, media duration or listening acceptance has yet been observed.
Coverage claims for the remaining 48 scored tasks and four examples are prospective; they must be checked again against E/F's complete authored branches.

Corpus independence means a genuinely different situation and connected decision, not a new ID. Independent review compared the eight pilots with all 396 Japanese turns across the 68 existing N5 records, with scenario/choice summaries. No consequential duplication was established; future complete E/F tasks still require review.

items.roles: Man arranges furniture; woman specifies today's discussion needs. Neither appears in the picture.
items.register: Polite volunteer/worklike exchange, including a tentative proposal and an explanatory refusal of a location
items.heard: Today's face-to-face purpose, rejected bright window location, construction-noise reason and entrance-side correction
items.seen: Four numbered alternatives encode combinations of desk position and chair-facing direction; no arrangement is highlighted
items.senseQualifications: 向かい合って denotes facing one another, not merely sitting nearby; 机をはさんで、一つずつ distributes the two chairs across the desk
items.n5DifferenceToVerify: Not the existing size/colour cup grid or a material-fetching story: a purpose constraint and a rejected spatial proposal jointly determine an arrangement
auditionRisks: 机をはさんで、一つずつ

items.roles: Woman has prepared equipment and proposes food shopping; man offers his pot and requests attendance checks first
items.register: Familiar friends, ordinary explanatory/backchannel language without heavy slang
items.heard: Completed borrowing/preparation, pot supplied by the man, unresolved two-person attendance and the woman's agreed first action
items.seen: Japanese action choices only; no picture
items.senseQualifications: 用意してある does not imply purchase; 来られるかどうか asks whether people can attend; その前に points back to shopping
items.n5DifferenceToVerify: Not just reordering school supplies or chores: another person's offer removes one need, while uncertain attendance creates a different prerequisite

items.roles: One organizer announces arrangements to participants; kitchen staff continue supplying food
items.heard: Attendance exceeds the plan; the group cannot sit together in the cafeteria; food service and opening remain unchanged
items.seen: Japanese reason choices only; no picture
items.senseQualifications: 座れなくなった is a changed capacity in this situation; 作ってもらいます places the group on the receiving side, without identifying individual cooks
items.n5DifferenceToVerify: Not choosing food, waiting in a restaurant or a family lunch arrangement: distinguish a moved eating location from continuing food preparation

items.roles: Woman receives belongings/help; her younger brother carries boxes, and he and Tanaka carry the desk; male friend only asks
items.register: Familiar conversation, including 受け取ってた = 受け取っていた
items.heard: Two antecedent helpers across turns; one-person carrying is impossible; the woman receives at the new room rather than joining the carrying
items.seen: Japanese participant choices only; no picture
items.senseQualifications: てもらった identifies the beneficiary viewpoint, not the performer; receiving delivered belongings and receiving a favour are distinct facts
items.n5DifferenceToVerify: Not mediated notebook return or delivery destination: resolve the joint performers while separating physical receipt from beneficial receipt

items.roles: Picture marks the left staff member; right visitor has the blank application form and pen; choice voice does not change between alternatives
items.register: Polite staff/visitor service language; all three alternatives are grammatical utterances but not equally fitting for this role/stage
items.heard: Two people at a counter, no writing yet, all numbered alternatives; narration does not identify which role the arrow marks
items.seen: Counter-side roles, blank form, pen and arrow to staff; no written response
items.senseQualifications: あったら introduces a possible unclear part rather than a past event; 書いてありません says no writing is entered here, not that the form is unavailable
items.n5DifferenceToVerify: Not an apology for damage or cashier change: role-dependent conditional explanation versus an embedded-question request and completed-assistance thanks
auditionRisks: 何も書いてありません

items.roles: Left traveler returns the borrowed camera; right owner receives it and is marked; narration does not name the marked side
items.register: Familiar friends; 行ってない = 行っていない in a wrong-stage alternative
items.heard: Trip already finished; borrowed camera being returned; future offer, borrower thanks and mistaken not-yet-trip assumption
items.seen: Left-to-right handover, travel bag, recipient's role arrow and one camera; no photo-taking pose
items.senseQualifications: 借りていた gives the past continuing loan; 使いたくなったら offers a future possibility without asserting another trip
items.n5DifferenceToVerify: Not taking a group photograph or initial umbrella permission: distinguish the owner's response at a completed-trip return from the borrower's thanks

items.roles: Requester still has the paper; respondent is asked to take it to reception at departure; another participant still needs to add a name
items.register: Familiar activity participants; request plus explicit negative timing constraint
items.heard: Before leaving, to reception, not yet, one name outstanding; every numbered response
items.seen: Only the standard numbered response controls; no picture or Japanese option text before answering
items.senseQualifications: 持っていく versus 受付から持ってくる are opposite directions here; immediate delivery is independently wrong even with the correct destination
items.n5DifferenceToVerify: Not a postal destination or simple return request: accepting the request must preserve a negative timing restriction and directional relation

items.roles: Familiar/senior speaker corrects their earlier instruction; addressee replies politely; no gender-specific premise determines the answer
items.register: Familiar explanation and polite confirmation; 間違えてた = 間違えていた
items.heard: Self-correction, withdrawn today requirement, latest Monday hand-in and sufficiency; every numbered response
items.seen: Only the standard numbered response controls; no picture or Japanese option text before answering
items.senseQualifications: までに is the latest completion time, not a start time; くれればいい gives sufficiency, not a new obligation to finish today
items.n5DifferenceToVerify: Not an isolated day/time correction: understand a relaxed deadline through sufficiency while rejecting a change in start time
